The '''Imcando hammer''' is a wieldable variant of a [[hammer]] mostly used for [[Smithing]], [[Crafting]], or [[Construction]]. It can be obtained through smashing [[Barronite deposit|barronite deposits]] on the [[Barronite Crusher|barronite crusher]] in the [[Ruins of Camdozaal]] after completing the [[Below Ice Mountain]] [[quest]]. 

When first obtained, the hammer will be in a broken state. The broken hammer can be fixed by using it on [[Ramarno]], who will repair it for 1,250 barronite shards. Once repaired, it can be used as a hammer, both while equipped and unequipped, in any way that a normal hammer can be used.

The Imcando hammer is especially useful in a few situations:

* When fighting [[Tempoross]], it will not be destroyed by flames nor be washed away by waves.
* When doing [[Mahogany Homes]] or [[Wintertodt]], it saves an inventory slot if wielded.
* In [[Barbarian Assault]], it can be used by the Defender to repair the Penance Runner traps. In this case, the Defender will save a small amount of time that is normally spent collecting a hammer from the battlefield.
* When doing [[Motherlode Mine]], you can repair the wheels without picking up a hammer first. You are also able to repair the struts without a small tick-delay (2 - 3 ticks).
* When [[crafting golem]]s. While using a [[gem pouch]] and [[large fur pouch]], a player can make 5 golems instead of 4 per inventory, increasing XP per hour and requiring fewer inputs.

The hammer can be swapped via the "Swap" option, converting it to its [[Imcando hammer (off-hand)|off-hand variant]] so that it can be equipped in the [[shield slot]]. This allows it to be equipped alongside [[Amy's saw]], a [[mist battlestaff]], an [[Harpoon (weapon)|equippable harpoon]], or a [[pickaxe]] when doing the aforementioned activities.

{{Costume storage|magic wardrobe}} Both the normal and off-hand variant can be stored in the magic wardrobe at the same time. Unwanted broken hammers can be exchanged at [[Ramarno]] for 350 barronite shards, while the fixed hammer can be exchanged for 500 barronite shards.

It can also be used in a [[free-to-play]] [[Server|world]], despite being a members item. Though it can only be equipped in a [[members]]' world, if it is already equipped or in the player's inventory upon logging into a free-to-play world, the hammer retains its usual functionality, regardless of the player's membership status.
